verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents that its bot can autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize, which covers the basic calendar-driven auto-capture. Nothing in the evidence describes controlling which meetings get captured. The Rules Engine is documented only for admin control over meeting access and privacy, not capture selection, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit Google Calendar and Outlook connection docs, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules (e.g., internal vs external, by organizer or keyword), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
